title: Research: the PR5413 caller publishes no stock coefficient
body:
## Contribution

`research/pr5413-stock-envelope-gap` — a finite missing-lemma result for card `selected-stock-envelope` (chooser seed `412404f28272cbf9b9347e60215fd911`, priority revision 7). **No new κ. The selected record is not edited.**

Suggestions 1 and 2 are not taken. `research/mixed-provider-admission` already maps the four-provider dispatch. `research/f7-weight-parity-census-correction` already reconstructs `01021323`. This PR binds the caller promoted in the current selected record.

## Established result

The selected PR5413 caller publishes kappa 605457647/200000000000 and does not publish a parent-reserve or depth coefficient; its stated gain 1/200000000000 is compiler headroom over 605457646/200000000000.

The selected record, the caller claims and the literal invoice agree on that kappa. The five assumption ids match. The recorded gain is typed as compiler headroom and the raw signed profile is unchanged. Storing that gain as `actual_stock_coefficient` is rejected. A forged reserve `128/1` is detected. The stock-margin chain still reads the bootstrap receipt and does not name this caller. Its cutoff arithmetic is not rerun.

## Limits

The check binds four pinned records. It does not search the rest of the caller capsule, derive a reserve, or run `make frontier5413-verify`. Replay passed on Python 3.12: `PASS_PR5413_STOCK_ENVELOPE_GAP` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
